Faq.title: Frequently Asked <highlight>Questions</highlight>
Faq.subtitle: Quick answers before you get in touch.

items.question: What do I get for 499€?
items.answer: A one-page landing page built with Next.js: design, development, basic search engine setup, a contact form that emails you, plus your domain and 12 months of hosting. One fixed price, no hidden extras.

items.question: How does the one-week timeline work?
items.answer: After a short intro call you get an onboarding form for your texts, logo, colors and examples you like. The week starts once everything is in. You get a first version to review, one round of changes is included, and the site goes live right after. You pay half up front and the rest at launch.

items.question: What do I need to prepare?
items.answer: Your logo, the texts for each section, your brand colors and a few websites you like. The more complete your input, the faster things move. Need help with texts or a logo? That's available as an extra.

items.question: What happens after the first year?
items.answer: You choose: keep a small yearly care plan that covers hosting, domain renewal and small updates, or take over hosting and domain yourself and get the full project handed over.

items.question: Can the site be changed after launch?
items.answer: Small text changes during the first year are included. Bigger changes, like new sections or features, are quoted separately.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.note: This English version is provided for convenience. The German version is the legally binding one.

sections.title: 1. Privacy at a glance
paragraphs: Protecting your personal data is important to us. This privacy policy explains which data we collect, what we use it for and which rights you have in this respect. The entity responsible for data processing on this website can be found in the <impressum>legal notice</impressum>.

sections.title: 2. Your rights as a user
paragraphs: Under the applicable data protection laws (GDPR), you have various rights. These include the right to information about the data we process about you, and the right to rectification, erasure or restriction of processing. To exercise your rights, please contact us using the contact details given in the legal notice.

sections.title: 3. Data collection on this website
paragraphs:
Cookies

We respect your privacy. This website therefore deliberately does not use cookies for marketing, analytics or tracking of your browsing behaviour. For this reason, no cookie banner is required.

Server log files

Our hosting provider automatically collects data that your browser transmits (so-called server log files) in order to ensure the security and functionality of the website. This typically includes the IP address, browser type, time and the page accessed. This data is used solely for technical provision and is not merged with other data sources. The legal basis for this is our legitimate interest (Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR) in a secure and well-performing website.

Contact form

If you contact us via the contact form, we store your details in order to process your enquiry and for possible follow-up questions. We do not pass this data on without your consent. Processing is carried out for the performance of a contract or for pre-contractual measures (Art. 6 (1) (b) GDPR) or to safeguard our legitimate interest in effective communication (Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR).

umami.title: 4. Web analytics with Umami
paragraphs: This website uses Umami, a privacy-friendly open-source web analytics tool. Umami does not use cookies and does not create user profiles. IP addresses are not stored, and visitors are not tracked across different websites. Only aggregated data is collected, such as pages viewed, referrer, browser, device type and approximate origin (country).

The legal basis is our legitimate interest (Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR) in statistically evaluating the use of this website in order to improve it. Since no cookies are set and no personal data is stored, no consent is required for this.
